title: Cap. III Sol. Rat. 10 close: not Predestinati — works profit; Father prepares repentance
pass_a_gloss: The heresy of the Predestinarians therefore is nothing to us, who with full mouth teach that works of piety profit unto the obtaining of glory; and that flagitious deeds even to the predestinated themselves so stand in the way, that unless they were cast off through repentance and newness of life, they could not arrive at the kingdom of glory. But the same heavenly Father, who gratuitously destined glory to them, has also infallibly prepared for the same this repentance and newness of life.
pass_b_english: So the Predestinarian heresy is nothing to us — we teach outright that works of piety profit toward obtaining glory, and that crimes block even the predestinated so that, unless cast off by repentance and newness of life, they cannot reach the kingdom of glory. Yet the same heavenly Father who gratuitously destined them glory has also infallibly prepared for them that repentance and newness of life.
source_text: Praedestinatorum igitur haeresis nihil ad nos, qui pleno ore docemus opera pietatis prodesse ad consecutionem gloriae; Flagitia etiam praedestinatis ipsis ita obstare, ut nisi per poenitentiam et vitae novitatem abjicerentur, non possent ad regnum gloriae pervenire. Sed idem caelestis Pater, qui gratuito illis gloriam destinavit, hanc poenitentiam et vitae novitatem infallibiliter etiam iisdem praeparavit.
